en: The Low Triplet, the Wholesome Triplet.

Conditioned by a state that is neither inferior nor unwholesome, a middling wholesome state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Six in the case of root; ... pe ... six in the case of non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is neither inferior nor unwholesome, an inferior unwholesome state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three in the case of root; ... pe ... three in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither inferior nor indeterminate, a middling indeterminate state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Six in the case of root, six in the case of predominance; ... pe ... six in the case of non-disappearance.
